title: Montford Reforms
definition: The Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms, embodied in the Government of India Act 1919, introduced the system of 'dyarchy' in the provinces and expanded legislative representation in British India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the constitutional evolution of British India, the growth of representative institutions, and the roots of federalism in GS-1 (Modern Indian History) and GS-2 (Indian Constitution and Polity).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Montford Reforms.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
